Script.name: Curing Swaps
Script.script:
function Stack(herb, amount) local Aff = Legacy and Legacy.Curing and Legacy.Curing.Affs if type(Aff) ~= "table" then return false end
local AffStacks = { ["kelp"] = {"asthma", "clumsiness", "hypochondria", "sensitivity", "weariness", "healthleech", "parasite", "rebbies"}, ["ginseng"] = {"addiction", "darkshade", "haemophilia", "lethargy", "nausea", "scytherus", "flushings"}, ["goldenseal"] = {"dizziness", "epilepsy", "impatience", "shyness", "stupidity", "depression", "shadowmadness", "mycalium", "sandfever", "horror"}, ["lobelia"] = {"agoraphobia", "guilt", "spiritburn", "tenderskin", "claustrophobia", "loneliness", "masochism", "recklessness", "vertigo"}, ["ash"] = {"confusion", "dementia", "hallucinations", "hypersomnia", "paranoia"}, ["bellwort"] = {"retribution","timeloop", "peace","justice","lovers"} }
herb = tostring(herb or ""):lower() local stack = AffStacks[herb] if type(stack) ~= "table" then return false end
local count = 0 amount = amount or 4
if herb == "goldenseal" then for k , _ in pairs(Aff) do if table.contains(stack, k) or string.starts(k, "unweavingm") or string.starts(k, "horror") then count = count + 1 end if count == amount then return true end end elseif herb == "ginseng" then for k , _ in pairs(Aff) do if table.contains(stack, k) or string.starts(k, "unweavingb") then count = count + 1 end if count == amount then return true end end else for k , _ in pairs(Aff) do if table.contains(stack, k) then count = count + 1 end if count == amount then return true end end end return false end
function withTarget() local players = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players if type(players) ~= "table" or not target then return false end local want = tostring(target):lower() for _, p in ipairs(players) do if type(p) == "string" and p:lower() == want then return true end if type(p) == "table" then local name = tostring(p.name or p.Name or ""):lower() if name ~= "" and name == want then return true end end end return false end
local function _enemy_class() local enemies = Legacy and Legacy.CT and Legacy.CT.Enemies if type(enemies) ~= "table" or not target then return nil end local row = enemies[target] if row == nil then row = enemies[tostring(target)] end if type(row) == "string" then if row ~= "" then return row end return nil end if type(row) == "table" then local cls = row.class or row.Class or row.enClass or row.cls if type(cls) == "string" and cls ~= "" then return cls end end return nil end
local _eh = (type(CuringSwaps) == "function" and CuringSwaps._eh) or {}
function CuringSwaps() if type(Legacy) ~= "table" then return end if not (Legacy.CT and Legacy.CT.Enemies) then return end
local enClass = _enemy_class()
local Aff = Legacy.Curing and Legacy.Curing.Affs if type(Aff) ~= "table" then return end
--Reprio(aff) will push the priority back to its default position --Prio(aff) will push the affliction to the 1 slot working as a psuedo Prioaff --Deprio(aff, "hard") will force an aff to 26 --Deprio(aff, [soft]) will move the prioritiy down 3 positions
if (Aff.impatience and Aff.asthma and Aff.slickness and Aff.anorexia and not Aff.paralysis) then --Aff.softlocked = true --Aff.truelocked = nil elseif (Aff.impatience and Aff.asthma and Aff.slickness and Aff.anorexia and Aff.paralysis) then --Aff.softlocked = nil --Aff.truelocked = true else --Aff.softlocked = nil --Aff.truelocked = nil end
if enClass == "Alchemist" then elseif enClass == "Sublimation" then elseif enClass == "Apostate" then elseif enClass == "Bard" then elseif enClass == "Blademaster" then elseif enClass == "Depthswalker" then elseif enClass == "Druid" then elseif enClass == "Infernal" then elseif enClass == "Jester" then elseif enClass == "Magi" then elseif enClass == "Monk" then elseif enClass == "Occultist" then elseif enClass == "Paladin" then elseif enClass == "Pariah" then elseif enClass == "Priest" then local ss = Legacy.Settings and Legacy.Settings.Curing and Legacy.Settings.Curing.SS and Legacy.Settings.Curing.SS.Settings local focus_on = type(ss) == "table" and ss.focus == true if Aff.inquisition then if (not focus_on) and (Aff.stupidity or Aff.anorexia) then send("curing focus on") elseif focus_on then send("curing focus off") end elseif not focus_on then send("curing focus on") end elseif enClass == "Psion" then elseif enClass == "Runewarden" then elseif enClass == "Sentinel" then elseif enClass == "Serpent" then Prio("impatience") Prio("hypochondria") elseif enClass == "Shaman" then elseif enClass == "Sylvan" then elseif enClass == "Unnamable" then elseif enClass == "2H" then elseif enClass == "SnB" then elseif enClass == "DwB" then elseif enClass == "DwC" then elseif enClass == "Shikudo" then elseif enClass == "Tekura" then elseif enClass == "Dragon" then elseif enClass == "Waterlord" then elseif enClass == "Airlord" then elseif enClass == "Firelord" then elseif enClass == "Earthlord" then elseif enClass == "PaladinDwC" then elseif enClass == "PaladinSnB" then elseif enClass == "PaladinDwB" then elseif enClass == "Paladin2H" then elseif enClass == "InfernalDwC" then elseif enClass == "InfernalSnB" then elseif enClass == "InfernalDwB" then elseif enClass == "Infernal2H" then elseif enClass == "RunewardenDwC" then elseif enClass == "RunewardenSnB" then elseif enClass == "RunewardenDwB" then elseif enClass == "Runewarden2H" then elseif enClass == "UnnamableDwC" then elseif enClass == "UnnamableSnB" then elseif enClass == "UnnamableDwB" then elseif enClass == "Unnamable2H" then elseif enClass == "Group" then Prio("paralysis") elseif enClass == "" or enClass == nil then end end
CuringSwaps._eh = _eh
local function _kill_eh(id) if id and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, id) end end
if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then _kill_eh(CuringSwaps._eh.aff_add) CuringSwaps._eh.aff_add = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add", "CuringSwaps") _kill_eh(CuringSwaps._eh.aff_remove) CuringSwaps._eh.aff_remove = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove", "CuringSwaps") _kill_eh(CuringSwaps._eh.room) CuringSwaps._eh.room = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", "CuringSwaps") _kill_eh(CuringSwaps._eh.yso) CuringSwaps._eh.yso = registerAnonymousEventHandler("yso.self.aff.changed", "CuringSwaps") end
